summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Arrangement Agreement dated May 12, 2026, under which Equinox Gold Corp. will acquire all outstanding Orla shares via a plan of arrangement under British Columbia law. The agreement includes voting support agreements from major shareholders and board recommendations based on fairness opinions. The transaction is subject to court, shareholder, and regulatory approvals. As a non-US filer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K for a material definitive agreement. Watch for shareholder meeting dates, regulatory timelines, and any superior proposal or termination fee triggers.
